== Injector Identification ==
[[File:GK2.7 OEM Injector.png|right|thumb]][[File:GK2.7 OEM Injector Nozzle.png|right|thumb]]
Many aftermarket "OE" injectors are either Chinese fakes or they perform poorly in our systems. It's important to know how to identify a genuine injector from a fake injector. Here are the main identifiers to look for when shopping for used, new or remanufactured/reflowed injectors.

# Kefico part number
# "Four Leaf Clover" or "Venus Korean Dogwood Flower"
# Hyundai "H" logo
# Hyundai part number
# "K" and "C" are stamped near the nozzles
